audit: Hobbs has moved to hobbs.com (old hobbs.co.uk/information/size-guide.list redirects to the home page). Main clothing chart in cm, UK 6-22; hips = Hobbs 'full hip'. US and EU from Hobbs' international size comparison (EU = France/Spain/Portugal/Belgium row). Letter sizes from Hobbs' S-M-L chart (S = UK 8-10 ... XL = UK 20-22). Hobbs' inch table gives UK 20 waist as 42.1 in, which does not match its cm table (101 cm) or its own petite inch table (39.5 in); the cm table is used. Old values 1-6 cm off from UK 12 up (e.g. UK 16 bust 104 vs 107, UK 20 bust 114 vs 119); UK 22 was missing.

Jigsaw's guide moved to /pages/size-guide (old /help/size-guide 404s). Jigsaw publishes inches only, keyed by UK 6-18; cm = inches x 2.54 rounded to 0.1, inch originals in _in (bust, waist, hip at fullest). No US/EU for clothing, so removed. Letter sizes are not stored: the chart's letter header spans XS over UK 6-8 and S over UK 10 only, while Jigsaw's own size filters group S = UK 8-10 and M = 12-14, so the letter mapping is ambiguous. Old entry was letter-based with XS = UK 8 (official UK 8 is 33/25.5/36 in = 83.8/64.8/91.4 cm vs old 83/63/88) and had no UK 6 or 18.

audit: Karen Millen's guide moved to /pages/informational/size-guide (old /gb/size-guide 404s). It now publishes letter sizes only, each covering two UK sizes, with cm ranges (Main Range XS-L, Plus XL upward); stored exactly as published rather than split into single UK sizes. US = USA/CAN row, EU = EU FR row. The Plus chart labels both UK 24-26 and UK 28-30 as 'XXL'; the second is stored under its UK label. Old entry had single UK 6-20 rows with values that matched no published chart (e.g. UK 8 bust 83, UK 10 bust 88).

Lacoste's old /gb/size-guide URL 404s; the body chart is now in each product's Size guide modal (Body Measurements tab, women's tops figure). Lacoste publishes letter sizes, each with FR/EU and UK sizes ('S - 34-36 - 6-8') and cm ranges for bust, waist and low hip; stored as published. No US published, so removed. Old entry had single EU-numbered rows with values matching no published chart (e.g. old EU 36/UK 8 bust 84 vs official S 82-86; old UK 16 bust 100 vs official L 98-102) and no XL (UK 18-20).

Free People's /help/size-guide pages (US and /en-gb) now 404; the chart is in each product's Size Guide modal, with a country switcher. Uses the tops chart in the United Kingdom view (native cm): bust and natural waist only, no hips for tops, so hips removed. UK/US/EU as published (XS = US 0-2 = UK 4-6 = EU 32-34). Free People's separate dresses/one-pieces chart has hips but different bust at the top end (L 100-104, XL 108 cm), so it is not mixed in. Old entry was one to two UK sizes off (XS = UK 8 vs official UK 4-6) and had no XXS.
